## Description

Please provide a summary of the changes proposed in this Pull Request and the problem they solve.

Fixes #(issue number)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New skill or enhancement (non-breaking change adding capability)
- [ ] Tooling or CLI improvement
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to behave differently)

## Checklist

- [ ] My code adheres to the project's coding standards and naming conventions.
- [ ] I have executed `npm test` and all automated tests pass.
- [ ] I have executed `npm run validate` and all canonical `SKILL.md` files pass manifest validation.
- [ ] I have run `node bin/ves-doctor.js` to ensure system and installation integrity.
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation in `README.md` or skill reference guides.
- [ ] If changing a canonical skill, I updated the single source of truth under `skills/<name>/SKILL.md`.
